summary: Chains of Eternity is the outer binding layer of Zebuxoruk’s prison. Void‑forged chains, temporal anchors, and eternity locks hold the prisoner outside time, preventing his return to the planes.
history: Forged during the first planar war to bind Zebuxoruk beyond time.
Temporal anchors were created to stabilize the prison.
Void chains formed naturally from collapse pressure.
The Eternal Binder arose as the guardian of the prison’s outer layer.
